meta.about_html:
Lock Jaw is a potent hybrid cannabis strain that combines the classic genetics of Pitbull × 88 G-13 Hash Plant, resulting in a perfectly balanced 50/50 hybrid. With THC levels averaging around 20%, this strain delivers both a euphoric mental lift and a soothing full-body relaxation, making it ideal for users seeking relief from stress, mood imbalances, or physical tension.

First cultivated by expert West Coast breeders, Lock Jaw quickly gained recognition for its frosty trichome-covered buds and dense, neon-green nugs. Its signature sour citrus and woody pine aroma is complemented by a lightly creamy exhale, making it a favorite for both recreational enthusiasts and medical users alike.

Lock Jaw’s effects begin with a cerebral uplift, leaving the mind feeling light, happy, and creative. This is followed by a tingly body relaxation that melts away tension from head to toe, making it an excellent choice for evening use, social gatherings, or creative sessions.

Why Lock Jaw Is a Popular Choice

Lock Jaw has earned its reputation for potency, flavor, and reliable effects:

Balanced Mental & Physical Effects:Lock Jaw provides a smooth head high paired with a relaxing body buzz, offering a versatile hybrid experience. Learn more about how THC interacts with the body for a deeper understanding of its effects.

Unique Flavor Profile:Expect sour citrus lemon, woody pine, and a subtle creamy exhale. Its terpene-rich composition provides both flavor depth and therapeutic benefits.

Medical Benefits Without Heavy Sedation:Lock Jaw is effective for managing stress, depression, mood swings, appetite loss, and mild pain. Its balanced effects allow mental clarity while promoting body relaxation.

Trusted Genetics & Consistency:With lineage from Pitbull and 88 G-13 Hash Plant, Lock Jaw is prized for its stable hybrid effects, dense trichomes, and consistent potency, making it a staple for hybrid enthusiasts.

  • THC Content: ~20%
  • Lineage: Pitbull × 88 G-13 Hash Plant
  • Flavor & Aroma: Sour citrus lemon, woody pine, lightly creamy
  • Effects: Euphoric, tingly, relaxing
  • Best For: Stress relief, mood elevation, appetite stimulation, social creativity

2. Lock Jaw Strain Composition Breakdown

Lock Jaw’s balanced hybrid effects are driven by its carefully structured cannabinoid and terpene profile. With moderate THC levels and a rich mix of therapeutic terpenes, this strain delivers both a euphoric cerebral lift and a soothing body high, making it a versatile choice for recreational and medical users alike.

THC Content: ~18–22% Lock Jaw is a moderately high-THC strain, ideal for users seeking a balanced cerebral lift and relaxing body high. Its THC levels deliver a euphoric mental boost while easing tension and stress throughout the body.

CBD Content: ~0–1% With very low CBD levels, Lock Jaw focuses on THC-driven effects, making it better suited for stress relief, mood enhancement, and creative or social activities rather than non-intoxicating wellness use.

CBG / CBN: Trace Trace amounts of cannabigerol (CBG) and cannabinol (CBN) contribute subtle therapeutic benefits, such as anti-inflammatory effects and mild sedation, enhancing Lock Jaw’s full-body relaxation and calming properties.

Limonene: The dominant terpene in Lock Jaw, limonene contributes to its bright citrus aroma and mood-lifting effects. It helps reduce stress and anxiety while complementing the strain’s balanced cerebral and body high.

Pinene: This pine-scented terpene supports alertness and mental clarity. In Lock Jaw, pinene balances the relaxing effects of other terpenes, creating a head-high that remains uplifting and focused.

Myrcene: Myrcene adds earthy undertones and enhances body relaxation. It works synergistically with THC to deliver Lock Jaw’s tingly, full-body calm and supports its soothing, stress-relieving properties.

Caryophyllene (optional): This peppery, spicy terpene interacts with CB2 receptors, adding anti-inflammatory benefits and deepening the body-relaxing effects of Lock Jaw, while rounding out its pine-citrus flavor profile.

Entourage Effect: Lock Jaw demonstrates the "entourage effect," where its combination of cannabinoids and terpenes work synergistically to enhance both mental and physical effects.

The synergy between THC and myrcene delivers a tingly, full-body relaxation with soothing, almost sedative qualities. Limonene adds a bright, uplifting cerebral spark that promotes mood elevation and reduces stress. Meanwhile, pinene and caryophyllene interact with CB2 receptors to support alertness, anti-inflammatory effects, and deeper body relaxation, making Lock Jaw a well-rounded hybrid experience.

meta.effects_headline: What Lock Jaw actually feels like.
meta.effects_html:
Lock Jaw delivers a balanced hybrid experience, offering both mental stimulation and full-body relaxation. Its effects are well-suited for recreational users seeking a mood boost and creative spark, as well as medical users looking for relief from stress, pain, or appetite issues.

Immediate Effects

Users typically report a rapid onset of heady euphoria that elevates mood and sparks creative thinking. This is complemented by a tingly, full-body relaxation that helps unwind after a long day. Many also notice increased sociability and a gentle creativity boost, making Lock Jaw a versatile strain for social or solo use.

Medical & Therapeutic Uses

Thanks to its well-rounded cannabinoid and terpene profile, Lock Jaw has been found helpful for managing a variety of conditions. It may support relief from depression, chronic stress, and mood swings. Its soothing body high can reduce mild to moderate pain, ease muscle tension, and stimulate appetite in cases of nausea or appetite loss. For patients interested in the medical potential of cannabis, this article provides an in-depth guide on therapeutic uses of cannabinoids.

Onset & Duration

When smoked or vaped, Lock Jaw’s effects are usually felt within minutes. Edible consumption produces a slower onset, typically 45–90 minutes, but may provide longer-lasting effects. The overall experience can last anywhere from 2–4 hours depending on dose and method of consumption. Beginners are advised to start with a low dose, stay hydrated, and avoid mixing with alcohol to minimize potential side effects. Learn more about safe consumption practices.

4. Lock Jaw Flavor and Aroma
meta.flavor_headline: How Lock Jaw tastes and smells.
meta.flavor_html:
Lock Jaw delivers a bold and complex flavor experience that mirrors its potent hybrid effects. Every inhale offers a burst of bright citrus, while the exhale leaves a lingering earthy and creamy finish, making it a favorite among connoisseurs and casual users alike.

Flavor Tasting Notes

  • Sharp sour citrus and zesty lemon upfront
  • Woody pine undertones
  • Slightly creamy finish on the exhale

These flavors create a balanced profile that is both refreshing and grounding.

Aroma Profile

  • Jar/Break: Intense citrus lemon with earthy, woody undertones
  • Ground: Sharp citrus layered with subtle pine and creamy notes
  • Smoked/Vaped: Pungent, earthy scent with faint diesel and creamy exhale

The aroma is both potent and layered, reflecting Lock Jaw’s rich terpene profile. Learn how aroma impacts the cannabis experience in this article on cannabis smell and effects.

Terpene Contributions

  • Limonene: Sharp citrus flavor, uplifting and mood-enhancing
  • Pinene: Piney aroma, boosts alertness and focus
  • Myrcene: Earthy undertones, promotes body relaxation
  • Caryophyllene: Peppery spice, supports anti-inflammatory effects

Pairing Suggestions

Enhance your Lock Jaw experience with citrus snacks, light desserts, or relaxing mellow playlists. It also pairs well with social settings, boosting creativity and conversation.

meta.cultivation_html:
Lock Jaw is a moderately challenging hybrid to cultivate, producing dense, resin-coated buds that demand careful attention to humidity and nutrient balance. With the right environment and techniques, growers can enjoy high-quality, terpene-rich yields both indoors and outdoors.

Difficulty: Moderate Lock Jaw is best suited for growers with some experience. Its dense, resin-coated buds require careful humidity management and attentive care to prevent mold and ensure healthy flowering.

Climate: Warm, dry, and low humidity This strain thrives in Mediterranean-like conditions. For indoor cultivation, maintain temperatures between 68–80°F and keep relative humidity below 50% during late flowering to protect dense colas from mold or mildew.

Plant Structure: Medium height with dense colas Lock Jaw grows with a sturdy frame and compact internodal spacing, supporting heavy, trichome-rich buds. Regular pruning and low-stress training (LST) or ScrOG methods improve airflow and maximize light penetration for optimal yields.

Flowering Time: 9–10 weeks Lock Jaw has a moderate flowering period, typically reaching maturity in 9 to 10 weeks indoors. This allows growers to harvest on schedule while still producing dense, resin-rich buds.

Indoor Yield: Approximately 400–450g/m² With proper environmental control and training techniques like LST or ScrOG, Lock Jaw can deliver impressive indoor yields with well-formed colas and high trichome production.

Outdoor Yield: Harvest by late October When grown outdoors in warm, dry conditions, Lock Jaw is typically ready for harvest by late October. Outdoor plants can produce significantly larger yields per plant under ideal sun exposure and airflow.

Growing Techniques: LST and ScrOG Lock Jaw responds well to Low-Stress Training (LST) and Screen of Green (ScrOG) methods. These techniques help manage canopy height, improve light distribution, and increase overall bud production.

Indoor Setup: Controlled humidity and airflow Use dehumidifiers and fans to maintain proper airflow and keep relative humidity below 50% during flowering. Adequate ventilation helps prevent mold, especially around Lock Jaw’s dense, resin-rich buds.

Outdoor Setup: Sunny and sheltered Outdoor growers should select locations with full sun exposure and minimal late-season rainfall. Raised beds or protective coverings can improve drainage and protect plants from excess moisture.

Growing Medium: Soil or hydroponics Organic soil enhances terpene richness and flavor, while hydroponics can speed growth and improve yields. Both methods are effective depending on cultivation goals and setup preferences.

Bud Structure: Dense and resin-coated Lock Jaw produces medium to large, tightly packed buds with a heavy coating of trichomes. This dense structure enhances its aroma and makes it ideal for those seeking visually appealing, high-potency flower.

Coloration: Neon green with amber undertones The buds display vibrant neon green hues accented by dark amber hairs. Some phenotypes may develop subtle purples or darker greens under cooler nighttime temperatures during late flowering.

Trichome Coverage: Thick and frosty A thick layer of frosty white crystal trichomes coats the buds, indicating high THC potency. This crystalline coating also makes Lock Jaw an excellent choice for producing concentrates or extracts.

Temperature Control: Cooler nights for color and trichomes Lowering nighttime temperatures to 55–65°F during the final weeks of flowering can enhance trichome production and bring out subtle purples, boosting both potency and visual appeal in Lock Jaw buds.

Humidity Management: Keep RH below 50% Lock Jaw’s dense, resin-rich buds are prone to mold and mildew. Maintain humidity levels below 50% during flowering and use oscillating fans or exhaust systems to ensure proper airflow throughout the canopy.

Nutrient Balance: Boost phosphorus in bloom Apply bloom-stage nutrients high in phosphorus and potassium to support bud density and resin production. Avoid nitrogen-heavy feeds during late flowering to prevent excessive leafy growth and muted flavors.

Pest Control: Monitor and apply organic solutions Regularly inspect for common pests like spider mites and aphids. Use organic treatments such as neem oil, insecticidal soap, or introduce beneficial insects like ladybugs for natural pest management.

meta.jar_headline: What to look for in the jar.
meta.jar_html:
Lock Jaw stands out with its chunky, oversized nugs that glow neon green, making it instantly recognizable. Each bud is densely packed and generously coated in frosty trichomes, accented by thick amber pistils curling through the structure. These visual cues not only signal potency but also reflect the strain’s high-quality genetics.

Key Visual Traits

  • Bud Shape: Chunky, dense, oversized nugs
  • Coloration: Bright neon green with amber undertones
  • Pistils: Thick, dark amber hairs
  • Trichomes: Heavy frosty white crystals indicating high THC levels; learn more about trichome development here

Harvest Cues

Growers can identify peak maturity with these indicators:

  • Trichomes shift from milky white to amber for optimal potency
  • Pistils darken and curl into deep amber shades
  • Buds feel firm but slightly sticky when ready for harvest

For best practices in identifying harvest readiness and maximizing potency, check out this Guide to Cannabis Harvest.

item-0.question: What effects can I expect from Lock Jaw?
item-0.answer: Lock Jaw delivers a balanced hybrid high, starting with a euphoric cerebral lift that enhances creativity and mood, followed by deep, relaxing body effects. At higher doses, some users report mild sedation, making it ideal for evening use.

item-1.question: Is Lock Jaw an indica or sativa?
item-1.answer: Lock Jaw is a balanced hybrid, approximately 50% indica and 50% sativa. It combines the relaxing, body-soothing qualities of indica with the uplifting, cerebral stimulation of sativa.

item-2.question: What does Lock Jaw taste and smell like?
item-2.answer: Lock Jaw has a bold flavor and aroma profile, featuring sharp sour citrus, pine, and a hint of cream on the exhale. Its aroma is earthy with subtle diesel notes, perfect for connoisseurs who appreciate terpene-rich strains.

item-3.question: How strong is Lock Jaw?
item-3.answer: With THC levels averaging around 20%, Lock Jaw is considered moderately potent. It’s suitable for experienced users or those looking for therapeutic relief without overwhelming intoxication. Beginners should start with smaller doses.

item-4.question: What medical conditions can Lock Jaw help with?
item-4.answer: Lock Jaw is often used for stress, depression, chronic pain, muscle tension, appetite stimulation, and mild insomnia. Its combination of THC and terpenes supports both mental and physical wellness.

item-5.question: How long do Lock Jaw effects last?
item-5.answer: Effects onset quickly when smoked or vaped, typically within minutes, and last 2–4 hours. Edibles may take 45–90 minutes to take effect and can provide longer-lasting relief. Duration varies depending on dose, tolerance, and consumption method.

item-6.question: Can Lock Jaw cause side effects?
item-6.answer: Common side effects include dry mouth, dry eyes, dizziness, or mild paranoia at higher doses. To minimize discomfort, start with a small dose, stay hydrated, and consume in a comfortable environment.

item-7.question: Is Lock Jaw good for sleep?
item-7.answer: Yes, due to its relaxing body effects and mild sedative properties, Lock Jaw can help with falling asleep and staying asleep, especially for users who prefer hybrid strains over pure indica.

item-8.question: Is Lock Jaw suitable for beginners?
item-8.answer: Beginners can enjoy Lock Jaw if they start with a low dose and monitor their reaction. Its balanced effects make it approachable, but caution is advised for those sensitive to THC.
